# UrukhaiMark documentation map

UrukhaiMark is a greenfield self-hosted product-marking system for Belarusian
manufacturers and exports to Russia. Documentation is Diátaxis
(tutorials/how-to/reference/explanation) plus planning/ and decisions/ (ADR).
Status: documentation only — application code not started.

## Read first

- docs/explanation/architecture.md — canonical architecture and scope
- docs/planning/architecture-validation.md — assumptions, NFR, gates
- docs/planning/roadmap.md — capability delivery order (slices 0–7)
- docs/reference/product-matrix.md — SKU routing source of truth
- docs/reference/datamatrix-spec.md — GS1 DataMatrix invariants
- docs/reference/api/reference.md — datamark API facts
- docs/explanation/integration-plan.md — integration boundaries
- docs/reference/data-model.md — target data model
- docs/decisions/README.md — architecture decisions

## Critical invariants

- GS1 DataMatrix, not QR.
- Preserve GS byte 0x1D exactly; never route KM through CSV/Excel.
- MVP cosmetics/RF uses datamark label_type=7 and indirect transfer to CRPT.
- addMark precedes addManufacture; shipment follows accepted prerequisites.
- Local production state, provider state, document state and package state are separate.
- PostgreSQL is the plant system of record; modular monolith first, edge only after gate.
